articles.event_key: 加州州长纽森|减刑|548名死囚
articles.title: 加州州长纽森为548名死囚减刑
articles.summary: 加州州长纽森将州内548名死囚的死刑减为终身监禁、不得假释；减刑需加州最高法院批准，并引来检方批评。
articles.new_facts: 纽森11月5日将加州548名死囚的死刑减为终身监禁不得假释；加州自2006年以来未执行死刑；减刑需加州最高法院至少4名法官批准；洛杉矶县检察官批评称只有立法机构或选民才能废除死刑。
articles.limitations: 减刑仍需加州最高法院法官批准；报道未说明每名囚犯的后续程序。

facts.text: 加利福尼亚州州长加文·纽森11月5日将州内548名死囚的死刑减为终身监禁、不得假释。加州自2006年以来未执行过死刑；纽森2019年已暂停死刑执行。

evidence.quote: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on death row in the state, changing them instead to life in prison.
The decision to spare death row inmates is largely symbolic in a state that has not executed an inmate since 2006
Newsom explained in his letter that he is exercising his constitutional clemency authority to commute the sentences to life without the possibility of parole.
Newsom had previously ordered a halt to the death penalty in the state in 2019.

facts.text: 纽森在信中说，死刑制度“失败”，无法公平适用，州政府不能合乎道德地杀人。减刑须经加州最高法院至少4名法官批准。

evidence.quote: He said that by every measure, California's system for administering the death penalty "is a failure", and that it has not and cannot be fairly applied
At least four of seven judges on the California Supreme Court will have to sign off on the commutations, CalMatters reported.

facts.text: 洛杉矶县检察官内森·霍克曼批评说，只有州立法机构或选民才能废除死刑。

evidence.quote: Nathan Hochman, the top prosecutor in Los Angeles County, said that while Newsom has the power to commute sentences, only state legislature or voters can eliminate the death penalty.

bilingual.title_en: California Governor Newsom Commutes Death Sentences for 548 Inmates

sentences.en: On November 5, California Governor Gavin Newsom commuted the death sentences of 548 death row inmates in the state to life imprisonment without the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州州长加文·纽森11月5日将州内548名死囚的死刑减为终身监禁、不得假释。

sentences.en: California has not carried out a death sentence since 2006; Newsom suspended executions in 2019.
sentences.zh: 加州自2006年以来未执行过死刑；纽森2019年已暂停死刑执行。

sentences.en: In a letter, Newsom said the death penalty system “failed,” could not be applied fairly, and that the state could not morally kill people.
sentences.zh: 纽森在信中说，死刑制度“失败”，无法公平适用，州政府不能合乎道德地杀人。

sentences.en: The commutations must be approved by at least four justices of the California Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 减刑须经加州最高法院至少4名法官批准。

sentences.en: Los Angeles County prosecutor Nathan Hochman criticized the move, saying that only the state legislature or voters could abolish the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶县检察官内森·霍克曼批评说，只有州立法机构或选民才能废除死刑。

articles.event_key: 法国工会|发动|全国罢工与抗议生活成本
articles.title: 法国全国罢工抗议生活成本 内政部称超60万人参加
articles.summary: 法国11月5日爆发全国罢工和抗议，内政部称超60万人参加，CGT称达157万人；工会要求提高工资，总理将召集社会会议。
articles.new_facts: 法国11月5日全国罢工抗议；内政部称超60万人参加，CGT称157万人；五个工会参与；总理勒科尔尼称下周一召开社会会议；警方部署7万人；一些城市出现冲突。
articles.limitations: 参与人数存在内政部与工会两个口径；社会会议尚未举行。

facts.text: 法国11月5日爆发全国罢工和抗议，内政部称超过60万人参加，左翼CGT工会称达157万人。五个工会参与，要求提高工资、改善公共服务并应对生活成本。

evidence.quote: More than 600,000 protesters have taken part in rallies and marches across France, according to France's interior ministry, with five unions joining a day of action demanding more money for wages and public services.
The left-wing CGT union put the number of people taking part in Thursday's mobilisation at 1.57 million

facts.text: 内政部事前部署7万名警察。一些城市出现冲突；总理勒科尔尼称下周一与工会和雇主召开“社会会议”，回应购买力和工资问题。

evidence.quote: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez had earlier deployed 70,000 police
Some unrest was reported in several cities.
As darkness fell in Paris, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said he would convene a "social conference" with unions and employers next Monday.

facts.text: 工会要求最低工资每月净增100欧元；当前最低时薪为12.31欧元。政府称财政空间有限，计划将赤字降至GDP的5%。

evidence.quote: In particular they are seeking a rise in the minimum wage, or Smic , which is currently €12.31 (£10) an hour.
We are asking for a net increase of €100 a month
the government by its own admission has little room to manoeuvre, as it looks to make tens of billions of euros in savings, in a bid to cut the budget deficit to 5% of GDP.

bilingual.title_en: Nationwide Strikes in France Protest Cost of Living; Interior Ministry Says More Than 600,000 Took Part

sentences.en: Nationwide strikes and protests broke out in France on November 5, with the Interior Ministry saying more than 600,000 people took part and the left-wing CGT union saying the number reached 1.57 million.
sentences.zh: 法国11月5日爆发全国罢工和抗议，内政部称超过60万人参加，左翼CGT工会称达157万人。

sentences.en: Five unions took part, demanding higher wages, better public services and action on the cost of living.
sentences.zh: 五个工会参与，要求提高工资、改善公共服务并应对生活成本。

sentences.en: The Interior Ministry deployed 70,000 police officers in advance.
sentences.zh: 内政部事前部署7万名警察。

sentences.en: Clashes occurred in some cities; Prime Minister Lecornu said a "social conference" with unions and employers would be held next Monday to respond to purchasing power and wage issues.
sentences.zh: 一些城市出现冲突；总理勒科尔尼称下周一与工会和雇主召开“社会会议”，回应购买力和工资问题。

sentences.en: The unions are demanding a net increase of 100 euros per month in the minimum wage; the current minimum hourly wage is 12.31 euros.
sentences.zh: 工会要求最低工资每月净增100欧元；当前最低时薪为12.31欧元。

sentences.en: The government says fiscal space is limited and plans to reduce the deficit to 5% of GDP.
sentences.zh: 政府称财政空间有限，计划将赤字降至GDP的5%。

articles.event_key: 巴拉圭总统培尼亚|辞职|银行倒闭引发政治金融危机
articles.title: 巴拉圭总统培尼亚因银行危机辞职
articles.summary: 巴拉圭总统培尼亚在Ueno Bank倒闭引发的危机中宣布辞职；国会将处理辞职批准与弹劾程序。
articles.new_facts: 培尼亚11月5日宣布辞职；危机源于Ueno Bank进入破产程序、业务冻结；众议院投票推进弹劾；国会须批准辞职；特别会议休会，周五再开会；培尼亚确认出席参议院弹劾程序。
articles.limitations: 辞职须经国会批准；弹劾程序仍在推进；议员对利益冲突的指控遭培尼亚否认。

facts.text: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚11月5日宣布辞职。此前，与该国一家银行倒闭相关的政治危机导致储户存款被冻结，并引发抗议。

evidence.quote: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña has announced his resignation following a political crisis sparked by the collapse of a bank linked to him.
The central bank seized the digital lender, and people took to the streets protesting and demanding Peña's resignation.

facts.text: BBC报道，危机源于Ueno Bank进入破产程序、全部业务冻结；培尼亚在视频中道歉，称无意背叛信任，并否认有不当行为。在他宣布辞职之际，众议院投票推进弹劾审判。

evidence.quote: The crisis erupted after Ueno Bank entered an insolvency process, which froze all operations.
I want to apologise to the people if at any point I failed,
It was never my intention to betray the trust you placed in me.
Peña rejected suggestions of impropriety. His resignation came as Paraguay's lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial.

facts.text: 国会须批准总统辞职。就辞职召开的特别会议休会，转而继续弹劾程序，并定于周五再开特别会议；培尼亚确认将出席参议院弹劾程序。

evidence.quote: Paraguay's congress must approve the resignation of a president. But a special session convened on Thursday to address his resignation was adjourned in favour of continuing with the impeachment process. Congress has scheduled a special session for Friday, when Peña is expected to present his defence, according to Reuters news agency.
In a post on X, Peña confirmed he would appear for Senate impeachment proceedings

bilingual.title_en: Paraguay's President Peña Resigns Amid Banking Crisis

sentences.en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña announced his resignation on November 5.
sentences.zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚11月5日宣布辞职。

sentences.en: Earlier, a political crisis linked to the collapse of a bank in the country led to the freezing of depositors' funds and sparked protests.
sentences.zh: 此前，与该国一家银行倒闭相关的政治危机导致储户存款被冻结，并引发抗议。

sentences.en: According to the BBC, the crisis originated from Ueno Bank entering bankruptcy proceedings and all its operations being frozen; Peña apologized in a video, said he did not intend to betray trust, and denied any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: BBC报道，危机源于Ueno Bank进入破产程序、全部业务冻结；培尼亚在视频中道歉，称无意背叛信任，并否认有不当行为。

sentences.en: As he announced his resignation, the Chamber of Deputies voted to advance an impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 在他宣布辞职之际，众议院投票推进弹劾审判。

sentences.en: Congress must approve the president's resignation.
sentences.zh: 国会须批准总统辞职。

sentences.en: A special session convened over the resignation was adjourned and turned to continuing impeachment proceedings, with another special session scheduled for Friday; Peña confirmed he would attend the Senate impeachment proceedings.
sentences.zh: 就辞职召开的特别会议休会，转而继续弹劾程序，并定于周五再开特别会议；培尼亚确认将出席参议院弹劾程序。

articles.event_key: 卢拉|拟设立|巴西公共安全部
articles.title: 卢拉拟以临时法令设立巴西公共安全部
articles.summary: 巴西总统卢拉表示将签署临时法令设立公共安全部，以协调打击有组织犯罪；该法令须国会通过才能成为永久法律。
articles.new_facts: 卢拉11月5日表示将用临时法令设立公共安全部；目的是协调联邦与州打击有组织犯罪、军火贩运和民兵；临时法令签署即生效，须国会通过才能永久化，有效期60天可延长；参议院3日通过公共安全PEC。
entities: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦
articles.limitations: 报道时卢拉仅表示将签署临时法令，未说明是否已经签署；国会表决结果尚未确定。

facts.text: 巴西总统卢拉11月5日表示，将签署临时法令设立公共安全部，以协调联邦与各州打击有组织犯罪、军火贩运和民兵。

evidence.quote: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva afirmou, nesta quinta-feira (5), que vai criar o Ministério da Segurança Pública por meio de uma Medida Provisória (MP).
A criação do ministério é para ampliar o combate às ações das organizações criminosas.

facts.text: 临时法令一经签署即产生法律效力，但须经众议院和参议院通过才能成为永久法律；有效期60天，可自动延长60天。

evidence.quote: Assim que é editada, a MP já produz efeito jurídico imediato. Ou seja, o ministério passa a existir oficialmente assim que a MP é assinada. Mas, para se converter em lei e se tornar permanente precisa ser aprovada pela Câmara dos Deputados e pelo Senado. O prazo de vigência da MP é de 60 dias, prorrogados automaticamente por igual período se a votação no Congresso não tiver sido concluída.

facts.text: 卢拉称，参议院3日通过公共安全宪法修正案后，设立该部是下一步。该部将统筹国家公共安全政策，加强联邦、州和市之间的协作。

evidence.quote: Lula celebrou a aprovação da Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) da Segurança Pública , ocorrida na última terça-feira (3), no Senado, e afirmou que a MP do novo ministério será o próximo passo.
A ideia de Lula ao criar o ministério é colocar a nova pasta para coordenar, em articulação com estados e municípios, a execução das políticas nacionais de segurança pública.

bilingual.title_en: Lula Plans to Create Brazil's Ministry of Public Security by Provisional Decree

sentences.en: Brazilian President Lula said on November 5 that he will sign a provisional decree to establish a Ministry of Public Security to coordinate federal and state efforts against organized crime, arms trafficking and militias.
sentences.zh: 巴西总统卢拉11月5日表示，将签署临时法令设立公共安全部，以协调联邦与各州打击有组织犯罪、军火贩运和民兵。

sentences.en: A provisional decree takes legal effect upon signature but must be passed by the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate to become permanent law; it is valid for 60 days and can be automatically extended for another 60 days.
sentences.zh: 临时法令一经签署即产生法律效力，但须经众议院和参议院通过才能成为永久法律；有效期60天，可自动延长60天。

sentences.en: Lula said that after the Senate passed a constitutional amendment on public security on the 3rd, establishing the ministry is the next step.
sentences.zh: 卢拉称，参议院3日通过公共安全宪法修正案后，设立该部是下一步。

sentences.en: The ministry will coordinate national public security policy and strengthen cooperation among the federal, state and municipal governments.
sentences.zh: 该部将统筹国家公共安全政策，加强联邦、州和市之间的协作。

articles.event_key: 尼日利亚高等法院|解散|反对党ADC领导层
articles.title: 尼日利亚法院解散反对党ADC领导层并裁定阿布巴卡尔提名无效
articles.summary: 尼日利亚联邦高等法院解散反对党ADC领导层，并裁定前副总统阿布巴卡尔的总统候选人提名无效；ADC将上诉。
articles.new_facts: 尼日利亚联邦高等法院11月5日解散ADC领导层并裁定阿布巴卡尔提名无效；ADC称裁决压制反对派并将上诉；阿布巴卡尔称对手恐慌；选举定于1月16日，选委会最终名单仍列阿布巴卡尔。
articles.limitations: ADC已表示将上诉，裁决对候选人资格和选举安排的最终影响尚待上诉结果。

facts.text: 尼日利亚联邦高等法院11月5日解散反对党非洲民主大会党（ADC）领导层，并裁定该党总统候选人、前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔的提名无效。

evidence.quote: Nigeria's Federal High Court has sacked the leadership of the opposition African Democratic Congress (ADC) party - and also ruled that the nomination of its presidential candidate, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, is invalid.
In a statement, the ADC added that Thursday's judgement by Justice Peter Lifu

facts.text: ADC称裁决是压制反对派，将向上诉法院挑战；阿布巴卡尔称裁决显示对手“恐慌是真实的”。

evidence.quote: A statement from the ADC said the ruling was another desperate attempt to cripple the opposition.
The ADC says it will challenge the ruling at the Court of Appeal.
In a statement on X, Abubakar, 79, said it showed the "panic was real" by those who felt threatened by his candidacy

facts.text: 总统选举定于1月16日举行。选举委员会已发布最终候选人名单，阿布巴卡尔仍在ADC候选名单上；报道称这场诉讼可能给该党数百名候选人带来不确定性。

evidence.quote: Presidential elections are scheduled to take place on 16 January
the electoral commission has issued its final list of candidates
Abubakar is on the ticket for the ADC with former Rivers State Governor Rotimi Amaechi as his running mate.
The legal saga could complicate things - it may cause uncertainty for hundreds of ADC candidates

bilingual.title_en: Nigerian Court Dissolves Opposition ADC Leadership, Rules Abubakar's Nomination Invalid

sentences.en: Nigeria's Federal High Court on November 5 dissolved the leadership of the opposition African Democratic Congress (ADC) and ruled invalid the nomination of the party's presidential candidate, former Vice President Atiku Abubakar.
sentences.zh: 尼日利亚联邦高等法院11月5日解散反对党非洲民主大会党（ADC）领导层，并裁定该党总统候选人、前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔的提名无效。

sentences.en: The ADC said the ruling was a suppression of the opposition and that it would challenge it in the Court of Appeal; Abubakar said the ruling showed that his opponents' "panic is real."
sentences.zh: ADC称裁决是压制反对派，将向上诉法院挑战；阿布巴卡尔称裁决显示对手“恐慌是真实的”。

sentences.en: The presidential election is scheduled for January 16.
sentences.zh: 总统选举定于1月16日举行。

sentences.en: The electoral commission has published the final candidate list, and Abubakar remains on the ADC candidate list; reports said the lawsuit could bring uncertainty to hundreds of the party's candidates.
sentences.zh: 选举委员会已发布最终候选人名单，阿布巴卡尔仍在ADC候选名单上；报道称这场诉讼可能给该党数百名候选人带来不确定性。
